Keep the original Guardian Mage proportions, narrow brown carved border, straight pale parchment scroll, small orange-brown title banner, typography, generous blank spaces, small chest separator and small pointed 1-Power reward tab. This is a matching variant, not a new style.
Change its title to "Conspirator Mage". Task at left of the large Trap illustration, exactly: "After you\nresolve the\nEffect of one of\nyour [Trap glyph] Spells." Use the provided official Trap glyph, not a shield or a rune. No progress cube slots. Keep the small chest divider at about 55 percent of card height.
At about 67 percent height put a Mage Model symbol (small bust with pointed wizard hat, as pictured in Field Test) followed by an asterisk for unlimited range: "inflict 2" followed by the exact pictured broken-heart Damage glyph. Next line: a hexagon containing 0, ": place 1", and a filled black circle Instability glyph. Bottom-right reward exactly 1 and the original white Power rose, small as in the source. Keep body and title lettering English. Do not invent a serial card code. No frame redesign, no torn parchment edges, no oversized lettering, no extra glyphs.
